# bmiddleton.dev

> bmiddleton.dev is the personal website of Bradley Middleton, a student and developer based in Indiana. The site contains information about Bradley, software and engineering projects, technical interests, and other personal projects.

The website is primarily focused on software development, computer science, engineering, robotics, artificial intelligence, and related technical projects.

## About

- [About](https://bmiddleton.dev/about/): Information about Bradley, his background, interests, and goals.
- [Contact](https://bmiddleton.dev/contact/): Contact information and methods for getting in touch.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://bmiddleton.dev/projects/): Overview of software, engineering, electronics, robotics, and other projects.
- [Software](https://bmiddleton.dev/projects/software/): Software development projects and applications.
- [Engineering](https://bmiddleton.dev/projects/engineering/): Engineering, electronics, robotics, CAD, and physical projects.
